entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> God standeth in the assembly of *God, he judgeth among the gods.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: How long will ye judge unrighteously, and accept the person of the wicked? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 82:3
segments: Judge the poor and the fatherless, do justice to the afflicted and the destitute;

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: Rescue the poor and needy, deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments: They know not, neither do they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are moved.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: ¶I have said, Ye are gods, and all of you are children of the Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

entries.title: Psalms 82:8
segments: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for *thou* shalt inherit all the nations.
